settings.template_description: Plan, write, review, and publish blog posts from idea to live

tasks.title: A card lands here the moment a topic idea comes up
tasks.description: Capture rough topic ideas as they come in, before any research is done. Include the working topic, target audience, and why it might be worth pursuing.

tasks.title: Set a priority level on each idea
tasks.description:
![1.00]()

![1.00]()

Set a priority (Low/Medium/High) on each idea card so that, when planning time comes, it's immediately clear which topics matter most, rather than having to scan descriptions to guess.

tasks.title: Move a card here once an idea is worth pursuing
tasks.description: This stage turns a validated idea into an actionable brief before anyone writes — keyword research, content plan, interlinking strategy.

tasks.title: Use custom fields for target keyword and search volume
tasks.description: Add fields for target keyword and search volume directly on the card. That data stays visible at every later stage without digging through a separate SEO tool.

tasks.title: A card moves here once the brief is locked and writing starts
tasks.description: The writer begins the actual draft against the confirmed brief and keyword.

tasks.title: Break the card into subtasks
tasks.description: Use subtasks for outline, first draft, add images, and internal links, so it's clear exactly where a post is stuck if drafting stalls.

tasks.title: The draft moves here once the first pass is complete
tasks.description: Editorial review and fact-checking happen here before final formatting.

tasks.title: Set a default assignee for this stage
tasks.description:
Set a default assignee so every card reaching this stage routes automatically to your designated editor, instead of manual assignment each time.



![1.00]()

![1.00](http://fluentboards-staging.local/index.php?fbs=1\&fbs_type=public_url\&fbs_bid=16\&fbs_comment_image=631889319224ac0f03a8db71e63712a9)

tasks.title: A card moves here once editorial review is done
tasks.description: Only production tasks remain — images, SEO checklist, formatting, scheduling in WordPress.

tasks.title: Feature tip — save your pre-publish checklist as a task template.
tasks.description: Save this stage's checklist as a reusable task template, so every post follows the same final steps without rebuilding it from scratch each time.

tasks.title: A card moves here once live, and stays permanently
tasks.description: This is your archive of published content.

tasks.title: Feature tip — pin your top-performing or cornerstone posts.
tasks.description: Use Pin Tasks to keep key posts visible at the top of this stage for quick reference when planning future interlinking or refreshes.

tasks.title: A card is created automatically when a client submits your intake form
tasks.description: Nothing added manually — submission drives creation.

tasks.title: Configure the Fluent Forms integration feed
tasks.description: Title, description, and submitter details map in from form fields. Enable "Map Files/Attachments to Task" for auto-attach, and "Create FluentCRM Contact" if the client isn't already in your CRM.

tasks.title: Move a card here once intake is reviewed
tasks.description: You're actively defining what's being built — deliverables, timeline, budget.

tasks.title: Add a custom field for contract value or budget
tasks.description: Visible at a glance on the card without opening a separate contract doc.

tasks.title: A card moves here once scope is locked and signed off
tasks.description: Design shouldn't start against unconfirmed scope.

tasks.title: Break the card into subtasks
tasks.description: Use subtasks for wireframes, mockups, and each client approval round, so revision cycles don't get buried inside one card.

tasks.title: A card moves here once the client approves the design
tasks.description: Development shouldn't start against unapproved work.

tasks.title: Set the default assignee to your lead developer
tasks.description: Every card reaching this stage routes to them automatically.

tasks.title: A card moves here once a build is ready for the client to see
tasks.description: And respond to.

tasks.title: Save this stage's checklist as a task template
tasks.description: Reuse the same review structure on every project instead of rebuilding it from scratch.

tasks.title: A card moves here once the client approves everything
tasks.description: Only final QA and go-live remain.

tasks.title: Log total time spent across the project
tasks.description: Compare against your original estimate — useful for pricing future projects.

board.title: Content Calendar Board
board.description: Plan and produce content from ideation through scheduling to publication

tasks.title: A card lands here once a content idea comes up for any channel
tasks.description: Social post, newsletter blurb, promo — not yet scheduled.

tasks.title: Set priority to flag time-sensitive content
tasks.description: Separates evergreen ideas from anything tied to a launch date or campaign window.

tasks.title: A card moves here once a publish date is confirmed
tasks.description: This is a commitment to a date, not just an idea anymore.

tasks.title: Use the Calendar View to see everything scheduled at once
tasks.description: The Calendar View lays out every card by its due date, so you can spot gaps or overloaded days across every channel in one glance instead of checking each stage separately.

tasks.title: A card moves here once someone starts actually creating the content
tasks.description: Writing, designing, or filming — active work.

tasks.title: Feature tip — add a custom field for channel (social, email, blog promo).
tasks.description: Keeps the channel visible on the card so filtering or scanning the board by platform is easy.

tasks.title: A card moves here once a draft is ready for approval before it goes out
tasks.description: Not final yet — pending sign-off.

tasks.title: Set a default assignee for this stage to your content lead
tasks.description: Every card reaching this stage routes automatically to whoever gives final approval.

tasks.title: A card moves here once the content is live on its channel
tasks.description: Archive state.

tasks.title: Feature tip — export published content to CSV for reporting.
tasks.description: Useful for reviewing output volume or content mix across channels over a given period.

board.title: Employee Onboarding Board
board.description: Guide new hires through every step from day one to full integration

tasks.title: A card is created automatically once a new hire accepts an offer.
tasks.description: Driven by form submission, not manual entry.

tasks.title: Connect a Fluent Forms new-hire intake form
tasks.description: Configure a FluentBoards integration feed on your internal new-hire form. Name, start date, and department map in automatically from form fields the moment the form is submitted.

tasks.title: A card moves here once the new hire's start date is confirmed
tasks.description: Pre-boarding begins — contracts, IT provisioning, account setup — all before day one.

tasks.title: Break this into subtasks for each access item
tasks.description: Use subtasks for contract signing, email setup, tool access, and hardware — so nothing is missed before the person's first day.

tasks.title: A card moves here once the new hire's first day arrives
tasks.description: Onboarding training starts — active ramp-up, not paperwork.

tasks.title: Save your onboarding checklist as a task template
tasks.description: Reuse the same training structure for every new hire instead of rebuilding the checklist from scratch each time someone joins.

tasks.title: A card moves here once the new hire has been onboard roughly a month
tasks.description: A scheduled review point, not an open-ended stage.

tasks.title: Add a custom field for manager feedback
tasks.description: Log check-in notes directly on the card so onboarding progress is visible without digging through email threads.

tasks.title: A card moves here once onboarding is formally closed out
tasks.description: Fully ramped, no more scheduled check-ins.

tasks.title: Feature tip — export completed onboarding records to CSV.
tasks.description: Useful for HR record-keeping or auditing onboarding completion rates over time.

settings.template_description: Communicate upcoming product features and priorities to your audience

tasks.title: A card lands here the moment any request comes in
tasks.description: A support ticket, a user comment, internal brainstorming — before anyone has evaluated it.

tasks.title: Set this stage's visibility to Admin Only
tasks.description: Nothing here is visible on your public roadmap until you deliberately move a card to a Public stage.

tasks.title: A card moves here once it's worth evaluating for feasibility
tasks.description: Before you've committed to building or publicizing it.

tasks.title: Add a custom field for estimated effort or complexity
tasks.description: Structured data to compare requests against instead of relying on memory.

tasks.title: A card moves here once you've decided it won't be built.
tasks.description: Out of scope, infeasible, or low demand.

tasks.title: Use the card's comment thread to record why it was rejected
tasks.description: Comments on Admin Only cards stay fully internal, so your team has a documented decision trail that never becomes public.

tasks.title: A card moves here from Pending or R&D once ready to be public
tasks.description: You're comfortable with it being visible to users.

tasks.title: Set this stage's visibility to Public
tasks.description: If FluentRoadmap is enabled, users can upvote and comment directly on the card from the public view.

tasks.title: A card moves here once approved and committed
tasks.description: No longer under consideration, but not started yet.

tasks.title: Pin your most anticipated planned features
tasks.description: Pin Tasks keeps them at the top of this stage so your team can see internally which requests are generating the most demand.

tasks.title: A card moves here once active development starts
tasks.description: Publicly visible progress begins here.

tasks.title: Break development into subtasks
tasks.description: Spec, build, test, docs. Subtasks stay internal even though the card itself is public.

tasks.title: A card moves here once the feature has shipped.
tasks.description: Final public state.

tasks.title: Feature tip — export launched features to CSV.
tasks.description: Useful for changelog compilation or quarterly reporting.

tasks.title: Create and utilize the FluentBoards Roadmap feature
tasks.description:
FluentRoadmap is an extension to FluentBoards that aligns all project stakeholders, providing a clear view of user requests, team status, prioritized tasks, and future goals.



**FluentRoadmap is Free** with FluentBoards Pro!

tasks.title: Set this stage's visibility to Admin Only
tasks.description: Nothing here is visible on your public roadmap until you deliberately move a card to Launched.

settings.template_description: Move deals from first contact to closed won with clear stage-by-stage tracking

tasks.title: A card lands here as soon as a new lead comes in
tasks.description: Cold outreach response, inbound form fill, or referral. Nothing needs qualifying yet — this is capture, not evaluation.

tasks.title: Link this card to a FluentCRM contact
tasks.description: Associate any card with a FluentCRM contact for full contact history, email activity, and tags without leaving the board. If FluentCRM automations are set up, adding a contact to this board can also trigger a funnel, such as starting a nurture sequence.

tasks.title: Move a card here once budget, authority, need, and timeline are confirmed
tasks.description: A card that fails qualification goes to Closed Lost, not backward to Lead.

tasks.title: Set a default assignee for this stage
tasks.description: Designate whoever owns qualification calls, so every card landing here is automatically routed to them instead of sitting unclaimed.

tasks.title: A card moves here the moment a proposal is actually sent
tasks.description: Not while it's still being drafted internally.

tasks.title: Break the card into subtasks for draft, internal review, and send
tasks.description: See at a glance whether a proposal is stuck in drafting, waiting on internal sign-off, or already sent.

tasks.title: Move a card here once the prospect responds with questions or requested changes
tasks.description: Active back-and-forth, not silence.

tasks.title: Add a custom field for deal value
tasks.description: With deal value set on every card, see total pipeline worth at a glance without opening FluentCRM separately.

tasks.title: A card moves here only once a signed agreement or confirmed payment exists.
tasks.description: A verbal yes isn't enough to move it from Negotiation.

tasks.title: Trigger a FluentCRM automation on stage change
tasks.description: Moving a card into Closed Won can kick off a CRM-side action — tagging the contact, starting an onboarding sequence — automatically, without a manual handoff.

tasks.title: A card moves here when the prospect explicitly declines or goes silent.
tasks.description: Past a defined follow-up window, or the deal is no longer viable.

tasks.title: Log the reason lost in a custom field
tasks.description: A dedicated "Reason Lost" field, filled consistently, lets you filter and spot patterns over time — pricing objections, timing, competitor wins.

settings.template_description: Track, prioritize, and resolve customer support issues through to closure

tasks.title: Agents add a card here once a ticket is worth tracking
tasks.description: A bug, a feature request, anything beyond a quick reply — added manually, not automatically.

tasks.title: Use the Fluent Support integration
tasks.description: From any ticket, use the three-dot menu and select "Add Task to FluentBoards." Title and description pull in automatically; if the customer is a FluentCRM contact, they're linked to the task automatically. This is a manual, agent-triggered action per ticket, not automatic ingestion.

tasks.title: Move a card here once it's confirmed real and needs prioritizing
tasks.description: Not a duplicate, spam, or already resolved.

tasks.title: Set a default assignee for this stage
tasks.description: Set a default assignee so tickets route automatically to whoever handles severity assessment, instead of sitting unclaimed.

tasks.title: A card moves here once someone is actively working the fix
tasks.description: Not just assigned — underway.

tasks.title: Break the ticket into subtasks
tasks.description: Use subtasks for reproduce, fix, and verify, so anyone checking the board can see exactly which part is holding things up.

tasks.title: Move a card here only when first-line support can't resolve it
tasks.description: Beyond normal scope, needs a specialist or developer.

tasks.title: Add a custom field for the assigned specialist and escalation reason
tasks.description: Structured, filterable data instead of burying it in a long comment thread.

tasks.title: A card moves here once a fix is live or an answer is given
tasks.description: Before the customer has confirmed it solved their problem.

tasks.title: Log time spent before moving to Closed
tasks.description: Time tracking gives real resolution-time data for spotting slow issue types and reporting against SLAs.

tasks.title: A card moves here once the customer confirms resolution.
tasks.description: Or a defined follow-up window passes with no response.

tasks.title: Feature tip — export closed tickets to CSV.
tasks.description: Useful for reporting or spotting recurring issue patterns over a longer period than the board view makes easy to scan.

board.title: Website Maintenance & Retainer Board
board.description: Organize recurring tasks, monthly work, and client escalations for retainer clients

settings.template_description: Organize recurring tasks, monthly work, and client escalations for retainer clients

tasks.title: This stage holds your recurring task
tasks.description: Setup, not new work generated per cycle.

tasks.title: Set up Recurring Tasks
tasks.description: Define a task once — monthly backups, plugin updates, uptime checks — and it regenerates automatically on schedule, instead of recreating it by hand every billing cycle

tasks.title: Holds this cycle's active work
tasks.description: Both recurring tasks that just regenerated and any one-off requests added manually for the month

tasks.title: Feature tip — duplicate this board for each retainer client.
tasks.description: Board duplication clones the entire structure — stages, recurring task setup, labels — for a new client instead of rebuilding from scratch.

tasks.title: A card moves here once someone is actively working it this cycle
tasks.description: Active work, not queued.

tasks.title: Break a task into subtasks for multi-site or multi-step work
tasks.description: Track each site or step independently instead of one card standing in for several.

tasks.title: Only used when a client needs to sign off on something visible
tasks.description: Like a design tweak — most retainer work skips this stage entirely.

tasks.title: Set the default assignee to whoever handles client communication
tasks.description: Anything landing here routes to them automatically.

tasks.title: A card moves here once finished for the cycle
tasks.description: Stays here until the next billing period.

tasks.title: Add a custom field for time spent
tasks.description: Compare actual hours against what the retainer contractually covers.

tasks.title: A card moves here when work falls outside retainer scope
tasks.description: Needs a separate conversation about additional billing.

tasks.title: Feature tip — set priority to flag which escalations need attention first.
tasks.description: Separate "needs a quote next week" from "site is down, needs addressing today," even though both sit outside the retainer.
